dedupe_keys.name: sotkanet statistics and indicator bank finland about 3 800 health and welfare indicators by municipality and wellbeing services county with rest api

description: Sotkanet is Finland's national bank of health and welfare indicators, gathering several thousand comparable series from registers and surveys in one place. It is run by THL, the Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare. Its API listed 3,797 indicators on the day read, covering population health and service use, including waiting times for primary care physicians and dentists against the statutory maximum times, hospital and bed-ward treatment periods, readmissions, and social care, with values by municipality, wellbeing services county and other regions and by year. Indicator descriptions give the source and definition. Data are free under the CC BY 4.0 licence, available through the web service and through an open REST API returning JSON. Caveats: indicator series start and stop as sources change (several waiting time indicators end between 2021 and 2024), regional units must be matched across years, and many indicators describe population health, not infrastructure. Simulation uses: setting regional demand and access indicators for healthcare capacity models, and tracking waiting times as a measure of service strain. Related records: the CIHI indicator library (data-cihi-indicator-library-and-data-tables) and the New Zealand health system quality dashboard (data-hqsc-health-system-quality-dashboard-and-atlas) are comparable national indicator services.
